notes.title: Update v1.04
notes.notes:
Update v1.04
-Increased the sound range of 100 yens
-Fixed panic system
-Improved AI
-Fixed mouse sensitivity options
-Relocated the flashlight
-You can now progress the game without picking up the flashlight 

For those who played the beta, make sure you delete the save data located below.
C:\Users\[USERNAME]\AppData\LocalLow\Chilla's Art, LLC\The Night Way Home
